reason: Bind every privacy-safe field consumed by generic and specialized comparators into publication and immutable trace identity.
changes: Comparator claims contain only controlled metadata while covering generic risk, activation, duration, and usage decisions.
Neo claims bind enablement, process outcome, timeout, deterministic pass, model invocation count, and duration.
Skill-development claims bind rounded score and blocker count without exposing blocker text.
Generic, Neo, and skill-development trace producers now hash the same comparator claims present in their final result records.
Publication content hashes include the controlled comparator adapter and risk strings as well as numeric and boolean claims.

red: changing Neo model-step count did not change trace or publication content hashes
specialized trace hashes did not reproduce from final result records
green: specialized claim changes alter immutable hashes without publishing raw blockers
generic missing-incumbent, Neo offline, and skill-development offline traces reproduce from final records
